Spice Tree Extravaganza

Blended Malt Scotch Whisky

46% ABV, Natural Colour, Not Chill-Filtered.

Thanks to our cooper friends in both France and Scotland, we were able to bring back The Spice Tree, and to celebrate the tenth anniversary of the original bottling being banned, we released Spice Tree Extravaganza. Retaining the trademark spice character, a richer more elegant frame with a new depth of flavour and complexity shines through the use of older components and a significant portion of sherry-cask aged malt whisky.
